title: Meeting notes → follow-up email
description: Paste rough notes from a meeting. Get the decisions, the owners, and a short follow-up email you can send.

steps.prompt: From these meeting notes, list: 1) decisions, 2) action items as 'owner — task — due date' (write 'no date' if none), 3) open questions. Use only what the notes say. Plain text, no Markdown.
steps.label: What was decided

steps.prompt: Write a follow-up email to the meeting attendees in a {{tone}} tone. Under 150 words. Include every action item with its owner. No subject line placeholder text; start with 'Subject:'. Plain text, no Markdown.
steps.label: Follow-up email

values.notes: sync w/ ana, raj, me. launch moved to dec 2 bc payments bug. raj fixes bug by fri. ana redo pricing page copy, no date. q: do we email waitlist before or after?
